profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at NVIDIA, ex-Google
profile.jobTitle: Senior Systems Software Engineer - CUDA Chips
profile.summary: I'm a professional software engineer with interests in music/audio/DSP, computer graphics and machine learning.

positions.title: Senior Systems Software Engineer - CUDA Chips
Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on smart glasses, creating vision experiences as a part of the Android XR team.

Responsibilities:
- C++, Java, Kotlin, Python, Jetpack Compose, Android app development, CV models, documentation, testing
- Worked in a cross-functional setting across multiple teams to deliver vision-based glasses experiences.
- Delivered across the complete product lifecycle: brainstorming, requirements definition, infrastructure architecture, computer vision application, feature prototyping, and full-stack Android XR app development.
- Product demoed at Google IO 2026 keynote - https://youtu.be/o8NiE3XMPrM?t=6157 (starts 1:42:36)
- Was a host for summer interns for two consecutive years. Both interns were later hired as full-time software engineers.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
I worked on the Digital Performer team, MOTU's digital audio workstation.

Responsibilities:
- C++11/14 programming and debugging, Python.
- Cross-platform UI development for Mac and Windows.
- Authoring key features for Digital Performer 10.0 release.
- Documenting new features in the company wiki.
- Wrote a graphics engine from scratch utilizing OpenGL for a currently unreleased product.

positions.title: Engineer
positions.description:
I worked on the core graphics software team. We developed drivers for Qualcomm GPUs targeted primarily for Android mobile devices.

Responsibilities:
- C/C++ Programming
- Mobile GPU driver development
- OpenGL driver programming with some minor OpenGL application debugging
- GLSL programming
- Debugging on both software and Android device platforms
- Full product life-cycle development from software simulation on Windows to FPGA to Linux/Android device
- Writing/designing/refactoring new and existing driver code to support new hardware features.
- Creating complete documentation for significant changes

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Display driver development for Windows CE 6/7.

Responsibilities:
- C/C++ Programming
- ARM assembly debugging
- Debugging and testing new code
- Coding according to proprietary device as well as VGA and 1080p interface specs.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
Helped update their embedded network stack to provide IPv6 functionality.

Responsibilities:
- C Programming
- Writing new code to support additional features that conforms to IPv6 RFC specifications
- Debugging and testing new code

positions.title: Extern
positions.description:
Helped produce a "15-minute out-of-the-box experience" for Sun Microsystem's Project Darkstar, an open-source MMO server-side framework.

Responsibilities:
- Java Programming
- Developing installation software tools and tutorial documentation
